label: preparing
what: The innkeeper, builder and freight are jointly preparing an evening great-hall gathering with a substantial reserved bread supply, under the name hospitality committee. Its actual occasion and guests have not been disclosed to me; explanations are deferred until eighteen hundred and I have been asked not to arrive early. The baker apparently supports the bread provision, while the secretary knowingly helps arrange my attendance and timing, but neither is established to know the undisclosed purpose.
